channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kyle Korver | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kyle Korver from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Kyle Korver, Mike Conley, Cristiano Ronaldo, Tom Brady
item.description:
Rudy Gobert:

“Yeah. Yeah. The first time I heard about a hyperbaric chamber, I was in Utah, and it was Kyle Korver. I know Tom Brady had one, Cristiano Ronaldo had one. Since I’m someone who wants to optimize my potential, I ordered one right away. I even gave one to Mike Conley. You always have to take care of your point guards.”

Rudy Gobert on Kyle Korver, Mike Conley, Cristiano Ronaldo, Tom Brady, Mar 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Duncan Robinson on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Kyle Korver, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson
item.description:
“I grew up watching a lot of Ray Allen, JJ Redick, and Kyle Korver. Obviously, Steph [Curry] and Klay [Thompson] have kind of revolutionized the 3-point shot as well,”

Duncan Robinson on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Kyle Korver, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, Jan 3, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kyle Korver
item.description:
Antetokounmpo said of the Pacers honoring Tshiebwe's feat.

“But at the end of the day you're talking about the guy that just skipped Kyle Korver in the all-time list. In my opinion, we should all stop what we're doing and appreciate greatness.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kyle Korver, Dec 14, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Max Strus on Kyle Korver
item.description:
“No disrespect to Kyle Korver, I think he is a great player, but I think I have a little more to my game. He is probably a better shooter. But I think I can do a little more with the ball in my hand or getting in the paint to create for others as well.”

Max Strus on Kyle Korver, Oct 26, 2023. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Kyle Korver, Landry Fields
item.description:
“The only role Landry and Kyle (Korver, assistant GM) and I talked about when I agreed to come to Atlanta is me coaching the team,”

Quin Snyder on Kyle Korver, Landry Fields, Jun 17, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Antony Ressler on Kyle Korver, Landry Fields
item.description:
“Right now, we're at 500. I think we should be better than that. I hope we will be better than that. And I can tell you this: Landry and [assistant GM] Kyle [Korver] are running a much better, much more collaborative front office. That's of huge importance to me because I think that's how you get better.”

Antony Ressler on Kyle Korver, Landry Fields, Mar 3, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: James Harden on Kyle Korver, Reggie Miller
item.description:
“I think No. 1 is definitely going to be hard to catch. You've got the best shooter that ever touched a basketball in Steph. But that realm from Reggie to Ray to Kyle Korver [in fifth place], I mean, those are some unbelievable shooters that we all witnessed shoot the basketball at a high level.”

James Harden on Kyle Korver, Reggie Miller, Mar 11, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jae Crowder on Kyle Korver, Duncan Robinson
item.description:
“I’ve played with a few. Probably top two. I think about Kyle Korver and I think about Duncan.“To be honest with you, Kyle Korver comes off one way, though. Duncan is coming off both sides, so he’s a little more dynamic in that sense. I don’t want to say he’s a better shooter, but he’s more dynamic because really Kyle Korver wants to come off the left side of the floor. If you notice, he wants to come off that left side corner. So, Duncan can come out and play both sides. He’s a little more dynamic.”

Jae Crowder on Kyle Korver, Duncan Robinson, Apr 16, 2020. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kyle Korver, Wesley Matthews
item.description:
“And at the time, Wesley Matthews and Kyle Korver were the guys I felt like could help us win.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kyle Korver, Wesley Matthews, Mar 4, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Kyle Korver
item.description:
Donovan Mitchell on support of teammates, notably Kyle Korver:

“Me being able to do what I do on a daily basis is not the norm. In this league, a second-year guy — even a first-year guy last year and my teammates have had my back with every mistake and everything I’ve done well.”

Donovan Mitchell on Kyle Korver, Apr 23, 2019. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Grayson Allen on Kyle Korver
item.description:
Eric Woodyard:Jazz rookie Grayson Allen on reading Kyle Korver’s essay on white privilege:

“It’s awesome for me to be involved and for me to experienceit.”

Grayson Allen on Kyle Korver, Apr 9, 2019. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Kyle Korver, Joe Ingles
item.description:
Jazz general manager Dennis Lindsey joked that Joe Ingles — who boldly declared himself as the league’s top shooter during the preseason — is no longer the best marksman on the roster.

“I’ve been greatly offended by Joe Ingles’ claim to be the greatest shooter on the planet. and as a proud American, that is comparing himself to Steph Curry and Klay Thompson and Kyle Korver, I was offended,”

Dennis Lindsey on Kyle Korver, Joe Ingles, Dec 4, 2018. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Dante Exum on Kyle Korver
item.description:
Eric Woodyard:Jazz guard Dante Exum on the addition of Kyle Korver via trade:

“He definitely can help us and hopefully I can learn a few things of just being able to shoot.”

Dante Exum on Kyle Korver, Nov 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Grayson Allen on Kyle Korver
item.description:
Grayson Allen:

“I can learn a lot from (Korver), what he does to prepare and from what I know of his game, he’s great moving without the ball. I’m sure there’s a lot I can watch from him and it will be cool to have that up close.”

Grayson Allen on Kyle Korver, Nov 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: JR Smith on Kyle Korver
item.description:
J.R. Smith on Korver:

“He has a tremendous checklist that he goes through when he shoots. Fortunately, I don’t think as much. I just try to get it up whenever I can. He shoots the same way every time no matter what, and for me, that’s hard. I take wild shots and stuff.”

JR Smith on Kyle Korver, Apr 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @JeffZillgitt.

item.title: LeBron James on Kyle Korver
item.description:
“But I do have sympathy not only for my brother, but for his family. It’s tragic for him to lose a little brother in the fashion that it happened. My prayers go out to the Korver family and everyone that has anything to do with his family. “I hope he takes as much time as he needs to get back to himself, which won’t happen obviously overnight or in the next couple months or maybe in the next few years. The healing process starts now and we’re part of his support group. He has a lot of support here. What else can you say, it sucks.”

LeBron James on Kyle Korver, Mar 21, 2018. Source: Akron Beacon Journal.

item.title: LeBron James on Kyle Korver
item.description:
LeBron James:

“I love professionals. Guys who come to work not on time, but early. Guys who work on their craft, work on their bodies, don't complain. Just being true professionals both on and off the floor. Who give you everything that they got. I can always give everything back to those type of guys and Kyle Korver is one of those guys.”

LeBron James on Kyle Korver, Nov 12, 2017. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: LeBron James on Kyle Korver
item.description:
LeBron James:

“Well, Kyle Korver is big time. He's someone that we rely on, especially when he's on the floor. He's just in the right place at the right time and hits big-time 3s. Also got an and-1 down the stretch. Just his movement, his body, his energy allows us to just keep defenses off kilter.”

LeBron James on Kyle Korver, Nov 12, 2017. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Iman Shumpert on LeBron James, Kyle Korver
item.description:
“That's what I'm saying. The media turned it into that for y'all. And that's what I said about the internet. It's the story. That's the clicks.'LeBron and Kyrie hate each other, ahhhhh.' No. It's two dudes that need the ball. LeBron needs the ball, Kyrie needs the ball, Kevin needs the ball. Swish can't shoot unless he has the ball. Kyle Korver can't shoot unless he has the ball. .... Somebody's gotta get the short end. And a lot of times fans can't all the way understand that. They think it's 2k. 'Bron can score 40, Ky can score 40, Iman should have 20, J.R. should have 30, this person should have this -- it's like, dog, it don't work like that.”

Iman Shumpert on LeBron James, Kyle Korver, Sep 18, 2017. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on LeBron James, Kyle Korver
item.description:
Richard Jefferson went on the Bill Simmons podcast at the Ringer and talked about the Finals:

“We lose 4-1, right. We didn’t play great. But KD hits that huge shot. Kyle (Korver) — who is one of the great shooters in the history of basketball — he has a good look, it doesn’t drop. That’s part of it. And then KD hits a tough shot over LeBron on a dribble-up. That close. You win the next game and it’s 2-2. People don’t understand: ‘Oh 4-1, they killed you.’ It’s like dude, it’s literally one shot here, one shot there. If it’s 2-2, you go there it’s Game 5. There’s zero chance — very similar to the year before — we do not lose on our home court in a Game 6 situation,”

Richard Jefferson on LeBron James, Kyle Korver, Sep 16, 2017. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Iman Shumpert on LeBron James, Kyle Korver, Kevin Love, JR Smith
item.description:
“No, it's two dudes that need the ball. LeBron needs the ball, Kyrie needs the ball, Kevin (Love) needs the ball. Swish (J.R. Smith) can't shoot unless he has the ball. Kyle Korver can't shoot unless he has the ball.”

Iman Shumpert on LeBron James, Kyle Korver, Kevin Love, JR Smith, Sep 15, 2017. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: JR Smith on Kyle Korver
item.description:
“He's probably the best one-on-one player already. And Kyle [Korver] would be a really good three-on-three player because he moves without the ball and he can catch-and-shoot the [expletive] out of it.”

JR Smith on Kyle Korver, Jun 11, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: LeBron James on Kyle Korver
item.description:
“If I could have the play over again, I would come off a screen situation. Draymond [Green] would switch on me with five fouls. I would get him leaning. I would drive left. I would see [Durant] step up. I would see Stephen Curry drop on Kevin [Love]. And I would see Kyle Korver in the corner, one of the greatest 3-point shooters in this league's history, and give him an opportunity in the short corner,”

LeBron James on Kyle Korver, Jun 9, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Richard Jefferson, Kyle Korver, Channing Frye
item.description:
Celtics'Brad Stevens:

“Korver, Frye, Jefferson, those guys were playing the right way up 45 freaking points. Tremendous examples for us.”

Brad Stevens on Richard Jefferson, Kyle Korver, Channing Frye, May 20, 2017. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on LeBron James, Kyle Korver
item.description:
“(Kyle) Korver and LeBron, those guys are talking about it. So our guys are just anxious to play and ready to go out there.”

Tyronn Lue on LeBron James, Kyle Korver, May 13, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: David Griffin on Kyle Korver
item.description:
“We are extremely pleased to be able to add a player and person the caliber of Kyle Korver to our Cavs family,”

David Griffin on Kyle Korver, Jan 7, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Kyle Korver
item.description:
Anthony Puccio:Atkinson on Cavs acquiring Kyle Korver:

“It was a great move. We're all making a mistake if we think Kyle is just a shooter.”

Kenny Atkinson on Kyle Korver, Jan 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: Taj Gibson on Kyle Korver, Dwight Howard, Al Horford
item.description:
KC Johnson:Taj Gibson on Dwight Howard vs. Al Horford Hawks:

“They still got Kyle Korver. He doesn’t miss a shot. They’re still one of the top teams in East in my book”

Taj Gibson on Kyle Korver, Dwight Howard, Al Horford, Nov 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Rick Barry on Kyle Korver, Stephen Curry
item.description:
Diamond Leung:Rick Barry on radio in Stephen Curry's hometown:

“He's not (best 3pt shooter ever) bc Kyle Korver's a better shooter than him right now.”

Rick Barry on Kyle Korver, Stephen Curry, Jun 16, 2015. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: Lionel Hollins on Kyle Korver
item.description:
Hollins said.

“Everybody misses, man. He’s a good shooter, I acknowledge that, we acknowledge that as a team, we game plan for him because he is a great shooter. But until he starts shooting 100%, we’ve got to play and be in position to help, and then recover, and close out. “It’s not like we’re talking (Stephen) Curry. Korver, he’s a great come-off-the-screen guy, he’s great with moving without the ball, but he rarely puts the ball on the floor like Curry and shakes you up.”

Lionel Hollins on Kyle Korver, Apr 21, 2015. Source: New York Daily News.
